product_one_liner.value: Karbon is cloud-based practice management software for accounting firms that combines client management, email, tasks, invoicing, and payments in one platform.
product_one_liner.notes: Karbon's product page describes a cloud practice-management platform for accounting firms and names client management, email, task management, invoicing, and payments as included capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: Karbon's public pricing page lists a per-user monthly price, establishing that it has a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Karbon's customer-story pages identify System Six and BKL as customers. | named_customers.0: Karbon's customer-story page names System Six. | named_customers.1: Karbon's customer-story page names BKL.

employee_band.notes: Karbon's LinkedIn company profile gives its size band as 201-500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters record identifies San Francisco as the city. | hq_country: The headquarters record lists the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Karbon's LinkedIn company profile states that it was founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The Medium company-blog index shows product-release roundups and company content, and describes the blog as covering customers and the startup journey. A post by VP of Engineering Dom Millar describes a company-wide shipathon and mentions a high-level technical design, but does not explain product architecture or implementation. The current Magazine index is framed as resources for accounting firms. The evidence does not show the two engineer-authored product-build posts needed to count as an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Karbon's public developer center links to API documentation, getting-started material, guides, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Karbon's job listing shows an AI Operations Lead opening with an application link; AI appears in the role title.

model_provider.notes: Karbon's AI product page states that Azure OpenAI Service powers Karbon AI.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Karbon's security page identifies its SOC 2 Type II certification and displays a GDPR-compliant claim. It says Karbon is not yet independently certified under ISO 27001; the PCI DSS statement describes Stripe's compliance, not Karbon's own certification. | compliance_certs.0: The security page names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The security page names GDPR as a compliance claim.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest financing is identified as a Series B round. | funding_date: The latest financing is dated July 17, 2024, so its date at YYYY-MM precision is 2024-07. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest financing as $10.5 million; this is $10,500,000 in USD.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile lists July 17, 2024 as the latest financing date. That predates the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Karbon has an Account Executive - Mid Market job listing with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Karbon's announcement says it introduced Kai on June 3, 2026. That product launch falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated announcement on November 11, 2025 says Brooke Brockman was appointed CMO. That C-level appointment falls within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Karbon account-executive job posting names Salesforce and Gong as systems for updating sales information and forecasts. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job post names Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job post names Gong.
